title: The classical tangent plane of a C^1 graph is its approximate tangent space
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, R real, and u : R^n -> R^l C^1 on the open ball Bo_R(0) of R^n. Put G(z) := graphPoint z (u z) = (z, u(z)) in R^(n+l) and Gamma := graphOver u (Bo_R(0)) = G(Bo_R(0)). For every x in Bo_R(0), the subspace tau := range DG(x) (DG(x) = fderiv R G x) is the approximate tangent space of Gamma at G(x) in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (SimonGMT Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Gamma (G x) tau): finrank tau = n, and for every phi in C_c(R^(n+l), R) the integral of phi over blowUpMap (G x) lam '' Gamma with respect to H^n = muHE[n] tends to the integral of phi over tau as lam -> 0+, where blowUpMap p lam w = lam^{-1} (w - p).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (graphOver u (ball 0 R)) (graphPoint x (u x)) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x).toLinearMap)
